answer: Make each new identity post a bond that climbs with the crowd it arrives in. Every epoch the network clusters accounts by timing, funding source and answer style, and the kernel of the rule is that the nth account in a cluster bonds n times the base amount for ten epochs. One honest newcomer pays a small deposit, but a farm of forty owes 820 base units in total and stands on a ledge where any exposed fake forfeits its bond. A zephyr of real signups stays cheap; a gale of clones does not.
